move: disc spins in from -180 while scaling and fading up, inner ring counter-rotates and locks, name tightens in
how: An SVG round mark (dark disc, inner ring with an orange accent arc and a centre dot) above an uppercase tracked wordmark. 0-45%: the mark rotates -180->0 while scaling .3->1 and fading .25->1 (expo.out, 0.9s); from 5% the inner group counter-rotates 200->0 with expo.out over 1.1s. At 25% the name fades up 14px as its letter-spacing tightens from .6em to .28em (power3.out). At 50% the inner group turns a further 90deg (power2.inOut) so the accent keeps moving. Exit at 78%: the mark rotates on to 120 while shrinking to .6 and fading (power3.in); at 83% the name lifts 10px and fades.
adapt: Replace the disc and inner ring SVG with the product's round mark, the orange accent (#ff6a3d), the wordmark and the cream background. Keep the 0.9s expo.out spin-in, the counter-rotation and the letter-spacing tighten.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the mark SVG and name inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the spin-in over 0-0.45D, name at 0.25D, extra turn at 0.5D, exit at 0.78D. Scope '.mark', '.inner', '.name' to el; the name from() (with letterSpacing) needs immediateRender:false when nested.
caveats: animating letterSpacing forces layout each frame; fine for one element
